comments.author: moving_zig
comments.body_html:
Hello, author. Would you say that the default values are comparable to live?

I personally don’t really want keys to be “guaranteed” every raid, but, in 3.8, I checked that damn car trunk in customs about 50 times before just buying the key lol. As such, I wouldn’t mind a little bump to the numbers so I could find the keys in, say, 10 raids at most, like it is on live. After playing with it a little, jacket/cabinets seem more frequent than on live.

It might just be me being stupid, but I didn’t quite understand how comparable the numbers presented are to live. I didn’t play 3.7, so I’m a bit lost on the comparison presented.

Cheers and thanks for the mod!
